text: S2-ITG-01 calibration per ADR-003: triage scores injury, drivability and habitability itself, so tenant TR-* rules for those keep only set_complexity (no double-counted add_severity). Theft reported more than 7 days late is a 0.35 fraud cue. Kestrel bands set to the 25/50/75 default. auto_rear_end_injury expectation is now major (one-line rationale in tests/synthetic/index.mjs). e2e pins ctx.clock to each scenario's reportedDate so report lag comes from the scenario.

S3-ITG-01 per ADR-003: root cause, S3-AI-01 made estimateTotal the grand total (~4003 vs 2090 parts) so the AI severity pass (src/ai/providers/local.mjs, tiers 2500/7500/15000, not my path) newly awarded +8, taking the towed rear-end injury from 71 to 79 = severe. Tuned in triage: estimate tiers re-based to 5000/12500/25000 (ESTIMATE_TIERS) and the delta vs the AI tiers applied as a calibration factor. Expectation unchanged (major). dir-ai may later re-base its own tiers; the offset then goes to 0 only if AI_ESTIMATE_TIERS is updated too.

S6-BUG-02 CSR-8 (server): agent persona cannot see the caller's policy. (1) GET /policies/{n}/snapshot is READ=[csr,adjuster,supervisor,integration] (src/modules/coverage/routes.mjs) so agent gets 403; allow 'agent' for policies it produces (redacted view). (2) GET /policies?q= returns every tenant policy to an agent: scope to producer. (3) Seeded policies carry no producer, so dev-personas says 'No producer data' and GET /intake/sessions/{id}/policy-vehicles is 404 for the agent (producesPolicy false): seed producer.agentId on a set of policies per tenant matching the agent persona userId. Until then the CSR app (src/web/csr/roles.js AGENT_ACCESS) skips snapshot and policy-vehicles calls for agents and shows the search summary only; flip the flags there once the server allows it.

S6-BUG-02 CSR-10 (server): agent gets 403 on GET /claims?limit=10&sort=-reportedAt and GET /claims/{id} (src/modules/claims/routes.mjs roles exclude agent). Request a producer-scoped list and read-only view for 'agent' (claims reportedBy the agent or on policies it produces, redacted like submitView). The CSR app now hides recent claims and the claim link for agents (src/web/csr/roles.js AGENT_ACCESS.recentClaims/claimView) and explains why; flip once the server scopes it.

S6-BUG-02 CSR-12 (tenant config): tenants/kestrel-point.json commercial auto question set has no 'insured_vehicle' (type vehicle) question, so POST /answers {questionId:'insured_vehicle'} returns 422 'Unknown question' and CA claims link no policy unit (only free-text unit_number). Please add an optional unconditional insured_vehicle (type vehicle) question to the commauto set. The CSR picker now shows only when the session lists a vehicle-type question, so it reappears automatically for CA once added.

S6-BUG-02 CSR-5 (server): coverage classifyQuery (src/modules/coverage/service.mjs) only takes letters-dash-digits prefixes, so full policy numbers (HO-IL-1030185 -> 400 bad_request) and two-segment prefixes (HO-IL, PA-WI -> lastName, 0 rows) do not match. Please accept the tenant format [A-Z]{2,5}(-[A-Z]{2})?(-\d*)? as policyNumberPrefix. The CSR client works around it (sends the leading segment and filters rows by the typed prefix) in src/web/csr/search.js.
